about:
Marcole Enterprises operates from Manchester, Tennessee, where it has built a wire harness and cable assembly business over more than four decades. The company does not disclose a founding year or ownership structure, and no founders are named in public materials.

The shop produces custom wire harnesses, cable assemblies, power cords, electro‑mechanical assemblies, and control boxes, using automated equipment described as state‑of‑the‑art. It maintains ISO 9001:2015 certification along with UL and CSA listings. Facility size, headcount, annual volumes, and part‑number counts are not published.

The firm says its products support “some of the most recognized companies in the world,” but it does not list specific industries or customer names in the available information.

Marcole emphasizes a quality culture — “quality isn’t a checkpoint — it’s our commitment” — and cites on‑time delivery and continuous improvement as operational pillars. No specific founding mission beyond general quality and reliability is stated.
